content: Moderation norms: member-facing Report on posts/comments with reason; mod queue; delete/hide content; remove member + optional ban (prevent rejoin); audit/moderation log ('who deleted this and why'); block (member-level, at least for DMs). Apple Guideline 1.2 for UGC apps requires filtering, report mechanism with 24h response, block abusive users, published contact info, EULA no-tolerance clause — a de facto industry baseline even outside App Store.
